title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (Alabama)
authority: Alabama employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: Alabama requires all private employers to use E-Verify for new hires (Beason-Hammon Act).

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: No direct fine for skipping E-Verify; knowing violations can lead to suspension of business licenses for up to 60 days on a first violation and revocation on later ones.
